projects.name: MARSWALK
projects.tagline: Interplanetary survival guide for the first people on Mars
projects.summary: A NASA Space Apps 2026 (Challenge #10) entry: a traverse planner for Jezero Crater built on real NASA and USGS data, paired with a Mars field-operations simulation game.
features: Six data layers: CTX imagery, 20 m DEM and slope, THEMIS, CRISM and USGS geology
Plans multi-stop science routes that avoid slopes above 15°, with instant re-routing
Visor HUD, 3D astronaut view and an EVA time budget
Companion game: pick a landing site and explore on foot, managing oxygen and battery

projects.name: Site Builder
projects.tagline: No-code website builder with live preview and versioned publishing
projects.summary: A full-stack website builder: create sites from templates, edit pages section by section, preview on desktop, tablet and mobile, and publish versions you can roll back.
features: Page and section editor with drag-to-reorder, undo/redo and autosave
Theme engine with presets, fonts and automatic colour-contrast warnings
One-click publishing with version history and restore
Custom domains, team roles and built-in form submissions

projects.name: GUtech Learn

features: Course and learning-material portal for students
Light and dark themes that remember your choice
Responsive layout for mobile and desktop
Fast single-page app built with React and Vite

Mobile-first design
Built with React and Vite
